run_spacy_inference_server: run a starlette server for spaCy NLP inference with gzip and optional CORS middleware
get_pipeline_task: get a cached NLP pipeline instance by task name and model ID from environment variables
add_allowed_task: add a new NLP task to the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary mapping task names to pipeline classes
configure_cors_middleware: configure CORS middleware on the starlette app by setting the DEBUG environment variable to 1
review_startup_event: review the startup event that configures uvicorn logging and initializes the NLP pipeline
